name: AIVON Plug-in for KiCad
description: Export manufacturing files and send your PCB project to AIVON for fast online quotation.
description_full:
Send your KiCad project to AIVON with one click for PCB fabrication and PCB assembly quotation.
The plugin automatically exports the manufacturing data required for production, eliminating manual file preparation and reducing the risk of missing or incorrect files.
When you click AIVON Plug-in button, the plugin generates:

- Gerber files in the right format for PCB fabrication
- IPC Netlist file
- BOM-file, including all information of components
- Pick and Place-file for PCBA

After the export is complete, your project can be uploaded directly to AIVON for an instant online quotation. The uploaded data is organized as a manufacturing package, allowing our engineering team to perform a Design for Manufacturing (DFM) review before production.
If you update your PCB design, simply export again to create a new manufacturing package based on the latest project revision.

About AIVON:
AIVON is an online PCB manufacturing platform providing PCB fabrication and turnkey PCB assembly services for engineers and hardware teams worldwide. From prototype to volume production, AIVON supports rigid PCBs, HDI, flexible PCBs, rigid-flex PCBs, aluminum PCBs, and complete PCB assembly, helping streamline the journey from design to manufacturing.
